knowledge:
- key_parameters: plusStrand=BigWigFileList containing plus strand BigWig files ;; minusStrand=BigWigFileList containing minus strand BigWig files ;; pooledCutoff=numeric threshold for calling unidirectional clusters (TCs) where higher values reduce cluster width and noise ;; mergeDist=distance within which to merge adjacent sites or clusters ;; balanceThreshold=numeric threshold (0 to 1) for identifying bidirectional enhancer candidates ;; unexpressed=expression threshold below which a feature is considered unexpressed ;; minSamples=minimum number of samples required to express a feature above the unexpressed threshold ;; swap="thick"=uses the peak position (highest pooled TPM) instead of the entire cluster range for annotation ;; directional=specifies reference points (e.g., "clusterType") to find directional links (e.g., TSS to enhancer)
- alternatives: Zenbu=online genome browser for interactive visualization of CAGE data (prefer for interactive exploration, while Gviz/trackCTSS/trackClusters are preferred for generating static figures in R) ;; DESeq2/edgeR/limma=packages for differential expression analysis (use after quantifying clusters or genes with CAGEfightR) ;; DEXSeq/DRIMSeq=packages for Differential TSS Usage (DTU) calling (use after filtering with calcComposition/subsetByComposition)
- when_to_use: When analyzing 5'-end sequencing data (CAGE, PRO-Cap, START-Seq, TSS-Seq) to identify transcription start sites (TSSs) and active enhancers, quantify their expression, annotate them with transcript/gene models, and analyze spatial relationships (TSS-enhancer correlations, super enhancers).
- pitfalls: Unstable tag clustering=A large number of very wide clusters (>1000 bp) or unusual locations relative to known genes can indicate noisy data; resolve by increasing pooledCutoff or pre-filtering CTSSs based on support ;; Bidirectional promoters detected as enhancers=clusterBidirectionally identifies any balanced bidirectional site; users must filter out clusters overlapping known promoters/exons using assignTxType and subset ;; Dropped genes during annotation=Genes with exons on multiple strands or reference sequences are dropped by assignGeneID unless handled ;; Overwriting assays/columns=Functions like calcTPM and calcPooled will overwrite existing assays or columns of the same name and throw warnings

workflows.name: cage_5end_analysis_pipeline
workflows.intent: Quantify, cluster, annotate, and analyze 5'-end transcriptomics data (CAGE, PRO-Cap, etc.) to identify TSSs and enhancers, calculate their correlations, and visualize them.
input: plus_strand.bw (BigWig files for plus strand CTSSs)
minus_strand.bw (BigWig files for minus strand CTSSs)
txdb_annotation (TxDb object or GTF/GFF3 file for transcript models)
workflows.stages:
1. Import and quantify CTSSs from BigWig files using quantifyCTSSs.
2. Normalize counts to TPM using calcTPM and calculate pooled signal using calcPooled.
3. Filter out noisy CTSSs using calcSupport or subsetBySupport.
4. Identify unidirectional Tag Clusters (TSSs) using clusterUnidirectionally.
5. Identify bidirectional clusters (Enhancers) using clusterBidirectionally and filter them using calcBidirectionality.
6. Quantify expression at the cluster level using quantifyClusters.
7. Annotate clusters with transcript models using assignTxID and assignTxType.
8. Calculate shape statistics (e.g., IQR) of Tag Clusters using calcShape.
9. Perform spatial analysis to find TSS-enhancer links using findLinks or super-enhancers using findStretches.
10. Annotate clusters with gene models using assignGeneID and quantify gene-level expression using quantifyGenes.
11. Filter clusters based on gene expression contribution using calcComposition.
12. Visualize CTSSs, clusters, and links using trackCTSS, trackClusters, and trackLinks with Gviz.
workflows.code:
# Load the example data
data("exampleDesign")
head(exampleDesign)

# Locate files on your harddrive
bw_plus <- system.file("extdata", 
                       exampleDesign$BigWigPlus, 
                       package = "CAGEfightR")
bw_minus <- system.file("extdata", 
                        exampleDesign$BigWigMinus,
                        package = "CAGEfightR")

# Create two named BigWigFileList-objects:
bw_plus <- BigWigFileList(bw_plus)
bw_minus <- BigWigFileList(bw_minus)
names(bw_plus) <- exampleDesign$Name
names(bw_minus) <- exampleDesign$Name

# Get genome information
genomeInfo <- SeqinfoForUCSCGenome("mm9")

# Quantify CTSSs
CTSSs <- quantifyCTSSs(plusStrand=bw_plus,
                       minusStrand=bw_minus,
                       design=exampleDesign,
                       genome=genomeInfo)

data(exampleCTSSs)

exampleCTSSs <- calcTPM(exampleCTSSs, inputAssay="counts", outputAssay="TPM", outputColumn="subsetTags")

exampleCTSSs <- calcTPM(exampleCTSSs, 
                        inputAssay="counts", 
                        totalTags="totalTags", 
                        outputAssay="TPM")

exampleCTSSs <- calcPooled(exampleCTSSs, inputAssay="TPM")

exampleCTSSs <- calcSupport(exampleCTSSs, 
                            inputAssay="counts", 
                            outputColumn="support", 
                            unexpressed=0)

supportedCTSSs <- subset(exampleCTSSs, support > 1)
supportedCTSSs <- calcTPM(supportedCTSSs, totalTags="totalTags")
supportedCTSSs <- calcPooled(supportedCTSSs)

simple_TCs <- clusterUnidirectionally(exampleCTSSs, 
                                     pooledCutoff=0, 
                                     mergeDist=20)

higher_TCs <- clusterUnidirectionally(exampleCTSSs, 
                                     pooledCutoff=0.1, 
                                     mergeDist=20)

prefiltered_TCs <- clusterUnidirectionally(supportedCTSSs, 
                                     pooledCutoff=0, 
                                     mergeDist=20)

BCs <- clusterBidirectionally(exampleCTSSs, balanceThreshold=0.95)

BCs <- calcBidirectionality(BCs, samples=exampleCTSSs)

enhancers <- subset(enhancers, bidirectionality > 0)

data(exampleCTSSs)
data(exampleUnidirectional)
data(exampleBidirectional)

requantified_TSSs <- quantifyClusters(exampleCTSSs,
                                      clusters=rowRanges(exampleUnidirectional),
                                      inputAssay="counts")
requantified_enhancers <- quantifyClusters(exampleCTSSs,
                                           clusters=rowRanges(exampleBidirectional),
                                           inputAssay="counts")

supported_enhancers <- subsetBySupport(exampleBidirectional,
                                       inputAssay="counts",
                                       unexpressed=0,
                                       minSamples=1)

exampleUnidirectional <- calcTPM(exampleUnidirectional, 
                                 totalTags = "totalTags")

exampleUnidirectional <- subsetBySupport(exampleUnidirectional,
                                         inputAssay="TPM",
                                         unexpressed=1,
                                         minSamples=2)

library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm9.knownGene)
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm9.knownGene

exampleUnidirectional <- assignTxID(exampleUnidirectional,
                                    txModels=txdb,
                                    outputColumn="txID")

exampleUnidirectional <- assignTxType(exampleUnidirectional,
                                      txModels=txdb,
                                      outputColumn="txType")

exampleUnidirectional <- assignTxType(exampleUnidirectional,
                                      txModels=txdb,
                                      outputColumn="peakTxType",
                                      swap="thick")

exampleBidirectional <- assignTxType(exampleBidirectional,
                                     txModels=txdb,
                                     outputColumn="txType")

exampleBidirectional <- subset(exampleBidirectional,
                               txType %in% c("intron", "intergenic"))

exampleCTSSs <- calcTPM(exampleCTSSs, totalTags = "totalTags")
exampleCTSSs <- calcPooled(exampleCTSSs)

exampleUnidirectional <- calcShape(exampleUnidirectional,
                                   pooled=exampleCTSSs,
                                   outputColumn = "IQR",
                                   shapeFunction = shapeIQR,
                                   lower=0.25, upper=0.75)

library(InteractionSet)
TC_pairs <- findLinks(exampleUnidirectional, 
                      inputAssay="TPM", 
                      maxDist=10000, 
                      method="kendall")

rowRanges(exampleUnidirectional)$clusterType <- "TSS"
rowRanges(exampleBidirectional)$clusterType <- "enhancer"

colData(exampleBidirectional) <- colData(exampleUnidirectional)
SE <- combineClusters(object1=exampleUnidirectional, 
                      object2=exampleBidirectional,
                      removeIfOverlapping="object1")

rowRanges(SE)$clusterType <- factor(rowRanges(SE)$clusterType,
                                    levels=c("TSS", "enhancer"))

SE <- calcTPM(SE, totalTags="totalTags")

TCBC_pairs <- findLinks(SE, 
                      inputAssay="TPM",
                      maxDist=10000, 
                      directional="clusterType",
                      method="kendall")

stretches <- findStretches(exampleBidirectional, 
              inputAssay="counts",
              minSize=3,
              mergeDist=10000,
              method="spearman")

extractList(rowRanges(exampleBidirectional), stretches$revmap)

data(exampleUnidirectional)

exampleUnidirectional <- calcTPM(exampleUnidirectional, 
                                 totalTags = "totalTags")
exampleUnidirectional <- subsetBySupport(exampleUnidirectional,
                                         inputAssay="TPM",
                                         unexpressed=1,
                                         minSamples=2)

library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm9.knownGene)
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm9.knownGene

exampleUnidirectional <- assignGeneID(exampleUnidirectional,
                                      geneModels=txdb,
                                      outputColumn="geneID")

library(org.Mm.eg.db)
odb <- org.Mm.eg.db

symbols <- mapIds(odb,
                  keys=rowRanges(exampleUnidirectional)$geneID,
                  keytype="ENTREZID",
                  column="SYMBOL")

rowRanges(exampleUnidirectional)$symbol <- as.character(symbols)

exampleUnidirectional <- assignMissingID(exampleUnidirectional,
                                         outputColumn="symbol")

genelevel <- quantifyGenes(exampleUnidirectional, 
                           genes="geneID", 
                           inputAssay="counts")

intragenicTSSs <- subset(exampleUnidirectional, !is.na(geneID))

intragenicTSSs <- calcComposition(intragenicTSSs,
                                  outputColumn="composition",
                                  unexpressed=0.1,
                                  genes="geneID")

intragenicTSSs <- subset(intragenicTSSs, composition > 2)

library(Gviz)

data("exampleCTSSs")
data("exampleUnidirectional")
data("exampleBidirectional")

exampleCTSSs <- calcTPM(exampleCTSSs, totalTags="totalTags")
exampleCTSSs <- calcPooled(exampleCTSSs)

pooled_track <- trackCTSS(exampleCTSSs, name="CTSSs")

plotTracks(pooled_track, from=74601950, to=74602100, chromosome="chr18")

exampleUnidirectional$totalTags <- NULL
exampleBidirectional$totalTags <- NULL

CAGEclusters <- combineClusters(object1=exampleUnidirectional, 
                                object2=exampleBidirectional, 
                                removeIfOverlapping="object1")

CAGEclusters <- subsetBySupport(CAGEclusters, 
                                inputAssay = "counts", 
                                unexpressed=0, 
                                minSamples=2)

cluster_track <- trackClusters(CAGEclusters, name="Clusters", col=NA)

plotTracks(cluster_track, from=74601950, to=74602100, chromosome="chr18")

axis_track <- GenomeAxisTrack()

library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm9.knownGene)
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm9.knownGene
tx_track <- GeneRegionTrack(txdb,
                            chromosome = "chr18",
                            name="Gene Models", 
                            col=NA, 
                            fill="bisque4", 
                            shape="arrow")

all_tracks <- list(axis_track, tx_track, cluster_track, pooled_track)

plotTracks(all_tracks, from=77182700, to=77184000, chromosome="chr18")

plotTracks(all_tracks, from=75582473, to=75582897, chromosome="chr18")

rowRanges(CAGEclusters)$clusterType <- factor(ifelse(strand(CAGEclusters)=="*",
                                              "enhancer", "TSS"),
                                              levels=c("TSS", "enhancer"))

links <- findLinks(CAGEclusters, 
                   inputAssay="counts", 
                   directional="clusterType",
                   method="kendall")

links <- subset(links, estimate > 0)

all_tracks$links_track <- trackLinks(links, 
                          name="TSS-enhancer", 
                          col.interactions="black",
                          col.anchors.fill ="dimgray",
                          col.anchors.line = NA,
                          interaction.measure="p.value",
                          interaction.dimension.transform="log",
                          col.outside="grey")

plotTracks(all_tracks, 
           from=84255991-1000, 
           to=84255991+1000, 
           chromosome="chr18",
           sizes=c(1, 1, 1, 1, 2))
